window: 2025-10-27 through 2026-10-27; older predecessors followed only for context
coverage: Targeted primary-source scan, not an exhaustive bibliography
queries: site:arxiv.org 2026 subexponential SAT tensor contraction algorithms
recent tensor rank sums of squares crossing decomposition
conclusion: Among the sources checked, no additional all-input classical 3-SAT result with alpha greater than 1/2 was found. Anthropic supplies a directly relevant different construction with the same alpha. Adjacent results require explicit transfer arguments.

papers.title: A 2^{o(n)} Time Algorithm for 3-SAT
papers.evidence_scope: Main theorem and Appendices A, B, D, E and H read; relevant formulas visually inspected; source artifacts pinned; no formal build replay
papers.reported_result: Deterministic exact counting in 2^O(min{k^2 n log log n/sqrt(log n), k m/sqrt(log m)}) time under the paper's normalization
papers.action: Incorporate operator crossing pieces and their complete bit-cost interface as a new research mechanism; retain the accepted selected result

papers.title: Exposition of OpenAI's Matrix Multiplication in Exponent 9/4 (and an explicit algorithm)
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract and metadata checked; proof not replayed
papers.reported_result: Explicit matrix multiplication exponent below 9/4+epsilon with base size at most 2^{(1/epsilon)^O(1)}
papers.action: Keep for explicit matrix-based subroutines; a faster polynomial subroutine alone does not lower the current SAT exponential envelope

papers.title: Simultaneous Matrix Multiplication by Tensor Contraction Aggregation
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract, revision and ancillary-file listing checked
papers.reported_result: Exact and border-rank constructions for selected batches of independent products; explicitly does not improve omega
papers.action: Use as a source of exact aggregation gadgets; prove both row and column factorization costs and any border-recovery precision before transfer

papers.title: Solving Restricted Versions of #SAT Faster than 2^m: Algorithms and Lower Bounds
papers.sat_alpha: 0 when used directly at fixed positive clause density
papers.action: Candidate bounded-instance or restricted-structure fallback; no all-input improvement on the accepted subexponential bound

papers.title: New Algorithms for Parity-SAT and Its Bounded-Occurrence Versions
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract, revision and SAT 2026 acceptance comment checked
papers.reported_result: Polynomial-space parity algorithms, including 1.1193^n for occurrence two and 1.1052^L in formula length
papers.sat_alpha: No direct SAT decision guarantee: even positive counts have parity zero
papers.action: Consider only with a separately paid weighted or isolation wrapper; cross-reference decision work in PR #2

papers.title: A Better Analysis For PPSZ For 3-SAT
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract and metadata checked; already cited by docs/PROBLEM.md
papers.reported_result: Randomized general 3-SAT in O*(1.307031578^n), by an exact dual-certificate recombination of existing analyses
papers.action: Retain as the historical constant-base comparison; no new incorporation needed

papers.title: Complementary Branching for #SAT: Bounded-Degree Bounds and Faster #3-SAT
papers.evidence_scope: Publisher abstract and proceedings metadata checked
papers.reported_result: Complementary counting branches; deterministic #3-SAT bound O*(1.637^n)
papers.action: A potential explicit fallback and test-fixture source; not an asymptotic replacement for the accepted theorem

papers.title: Near-Quadratic Time Multivariate Polynomial Interpolation
papers.reported_result: N^{2+o(1)} poly(m,d,log|F|) interpolation under the stated matrix conditions; general case randomized Las Vegas
papers.action: Only useful after a changed recovery problem; current recovery already has polynomial overhead, and finite-field hypotheses do not automatically apply to the two-adic ring

papers.title: Blocky Matrices and Group Idempotents
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract, blocky-matrix definition and theorem statements in pages 1-3 read
papers.reported_result: Signed equality-kernel decomposition with at most 2^{O(gamma^4)} pieces, improving the earlier gamma^6 dependence
papers.action: Useful structural lead, but a single blocky matrix can have arbitrarily many blocks and full rank; piece count is not the crossing bit-cost contract

papers.title: Beyond Bilinear Complexity: What Works and What Breaks with Many Modes?
papers.reported_result: Rank and circuit-complexity bounds for higher-mode tensors; limitations on extending circuit submultiplicativity, under the stated hypotheses
papers.action: Retain as a transfer warning: low circuit complexity, rank and both directional crossing costs must not be identified without proof

papers.title: Multiquadratic Sum-of-Squares Lower Bounds Imply VNC^1 != VNP
papers.evidence_scope: Primary abstract and Anthropic's citation to the crossing interpretation checked
papers.reported_result: Conditional connection from explicit multiquadratic SoS lower bounds to arithmetic-formula lower bounds
papers.action: Predecessor context for the crossing/SoS connection; not a new SAT algorithm

papers.title: Near-Inverse-Linear Barriers for Explicit Affine Witness Isolation
papers.reported_result: Specified strong nonuniform explicit affine-isolation guarantees imply NP subset P/poly; the inverse-linear endpoint is not claimed
papers.action: Do not assume a polynomial-resource constant-success isolation primitive as a free step; this is a scoped implication, not an unconditional runtime lower bound
